note.en: Capabilities of engines and models as data. Written by the Models strand from vendor documentation; not verified on the device. Entries marked unknown stay adjustable and are flagged so they can be tried (probe).

states.unknown: adjustable and sent, flagged as unverified
states.off: greyed out, not sent (the engine ignores it or does not have it)
states.error: greyed out, not sent (the request is rejected with an error)
states.fixed: greyed out, shows the fixed value of the model
states.config: not part of the request; set through the engine's server configuration (needs server.py, see KONZEPT 19.4); greyed out until then

rules.resolve: 1. engineFor(provider, baseUrl): the first endpointRules entry whose hostContains is part of baseUrl wins, otherwise engines[provider.id], otherwise engines.openai. 2. modelRule: the first models entry whose match (case-insensitive regex on the model id without a leading 'models/') fits and whose engine equals the resolved engine or the engine named in engines[engine].modelRulesFrom. 3. The cell of a parameter is engines[engine].params[key] merged with models[i].params[key] (model overrides).

note.en: One definition for every engine so dashboards compare. Open: does the engine's output count include the thinking tokens (stats.outputIncludesReasoning).

fields.outputTokens: all generated tokens as the engine counts them
fields.reasoningTokens: thinking tokens, 0 if the engine does not report them
fields.visibleTokens: answer tokens the user sees; outputTokens minus reasoningTokens when the engine includes them, otherwise outputTokens
fields.source: 'provider' when the engine reported usage, 'estimate' when counted from stream chunks (existing flag: approx)
fields.tokensPerSecAll: visibleTokens + reasoningTokens per second of generation

note.en: Input and output kinds and call types per model, and the function slots built on them (KONZEPT 20). Detection: engine, model-name pattern, fields of the model list. Where the list says nothing the entry carries status 'vermutet'. First matching rule wins.

note.en: Function slots (KONZEPT 20.1). A module asks for a function, never for a model. 'needs' is what a model must offer to fill the slot.
note.de: Funktionsplätze (KONZEPT 20.1). Ein Modul fragt nach einer Funktion, nie nach einem Modell. „needs“ nennt, was ein Modell können muss.

note.en: Local first (Gemma over LiteRT-LM or classic text recognition), cloud optional.
note.de: Zuerst lokal (Gemma über LiteRT-LM oder klassische Texterkennung), Cloud zuschaltbar.

note.en: Output must be marked as AI-generated (KONZEPT 20.7).
note.de: Ausgabe ist als KI-erzeugt zu kennzeichnen (KONZEPT 20.7).

note.en: What the app stores per function slot (settings). A slot holds a wish and a ranking, never a bare model name.
note.de: Was die App je Funktionsplatz speichert (Einstellungen). Ein Platz hält Wunsch und Rangfolge, nie nur einen Modellnamen.

fields.ranking: list, tried in order. {engine, model} names one model; {engine, family, pick:'newest'} means: of all models of that engine whose id matches the regex family and whose mediaRule fits the function's needs, the newest; {engine} alone means any model of the engine that fits.
fields.preferStable: true (default): rank by stability first (no 'preview' or 'exp' in the id beats preview beats exp), then by version; false: version only.
fields.conditions: online: needs 'Online erlauben'; engineReachable: the engine answers (home server).
fields.onMissing: 'next' (default): continue with the next ranking entry; 'stop': report unavailable at once.
fields.ifNone: 'unavailable': slot shows 'not available' with the reason; the tool stays usable without the function.

assignmentFormat.versionOrder: newest = highest tuple of the numbers in the id, compared piece by piece ('gemini-3.1-flash-image' gives (3,1); 'gemini-3-pro-image' gives (3,0); 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' gives (2,5)). Equal tuples: GA before preview before exp, then the longer id loses.

ok.de: Der Platz nutzt den bevorzugten Eintrag.

replaced.en: The preferred model is gone; replaced by the next entry. The UI says it: "{function}: {old} replaced by {new}".
replaced.de: Das bevorzugte Modell fehlt; der nächste Eintrag tritt ein. Die Oberfläche sagt es: „{function}: {old} ersetzt durch {new}“.

unavailable.en: No entry fits. The UI shows 'not available' and the reason (engine offline, online lock, no model with the ability).
unavailable.de: Kein Eintrag passt. Die Oberfläche zeigt „nicht verfügbar“ mit Grund (Engine offline, Online-Sperre, kein Modell mit der Fähigkeit).

assignmentFormat.when: At every start and after every model-list fetch; never silently, the user can change the choice.

note.en: How a model leaves the stage at the provider and how the app notices. Google researched 2026-11-11; other engines open (SCHNITTSTELLEN section 11).
note.de: Wie ein Modell beim Anbieter abgelöst wird und woran die App es merkt. Google recherchiert am 11.11.2026; andere Engines offen (SCHNITTSTELLEN Abschnitt 11).

signals.text: The model id is no longer in models.list.
Call returns 404 NOT_FOUND: 'This model models/<id> is no longer available' (also 'no longer available to new users'). The text sometimes names a replacement ('use models/<new>').
A model can answer 404 'no longer available' while models.list still returns it, and before the published shutdown date (reports for 2.5-flash in July 2026, shutdown date October 16, 2026).
404 'models/<id> is not found for API version v1beta, or is not supported for generateContent. Call ListModels ...' means unknown id or wrong method.

A deprecated id can keep answering while the provider routes it to a newer model (reported for gemini-3.7-flash to gemini-3.8-flash, October 2026). The response then comes from another model than the one asked for.

errorPatterns.regex: is not found for API version|is not supported for

errorPatterns.note: Optional hint for the UI; never switch on it without telling the user.

table.semantics: Published dates are the earliest possible shutdown; the exact date follows with notice (vendor wording, paraphrased). 'No shutdown date announced' means none yet. A table row can name a replacement before any date exists. It is a web page, not an API field: no machine-readable deprecation flag was found in models.list.

aliases.note: Seen in a forum answer as supported on v1beta; which model it points to changes over time.

google.recordModelInReport: Record the model that actually answered next to the model asked for (generateContent response field modelVersion, prior knowledge, vermutet) in the test report, so silent rerouting becomes visible.

seed.note: Small starting list for the replacement hint, read from search excerpts of the vendor table; refresh by hand. Never used to switch a model silently.

entries.note: Replacement named in an error text reported in a forum; answers 404 earlier than the date.
